Runbook Owner: Platform team Updated: 2030-05-16

Issue and deploy a new certificate for the payment gateway

Replace the TLS certificate of the gateway's internal endpoint before it expires, or at once when it has. Takes about 20 minutes; checkout keeps working throughout.

Before you start

  • You can run kubectl against the payments cluster
  • You hold the cert-issuer role in the vault
  • The on-call engineer of the payments team knows you are starting

Do not delete the old secret until checkout works on the new one; the gateway cannot start without a certificate.

Steps

  1. Issue the certificate

    If it fails A permission denied means the role is missing; ask the platform team for cert-issuer.

  2. Store it as a new secret

    Name it with today's date, so the old one stays until the end.

  3. Point the gateway at the new secret

    If it fails Roll back at once (below), then page the on-call engineer.

  4. Check that checkout works

    Payments on-call

    Place a test order on the staging shop and watch the checkout error rate on the dashboard for five minutes.

  5. Delete the old secret

Roll back

  1. Point the gateway back at the old secret

  2. Tell the on-call engineer

    Say which step failed and what it printed.
